_about: Hand-checked station pairs for crossings at a junction, where scripts/derive-crossing-stations.js can't tell the lines apart by geometry. Crossing number -> the stations either side, as CRS codes. Check the crossing's railway on OpenStreetMap (its way carries the line name and ELR).

1962.why: Keymer: on the East Coastway (OSM way 307180159, ELR KJE1) just south of Keymer Junction, between Wivelsfield and Plumpton; the Brighton main line (Wivelsfield-Burgess Hill) passes 50 m away. Checked 2026-11-23.
